mxCell.value: Processing and receiving an order from the store

Customer is notified 
that the order is picked up
by the logistics

Customer is notified 
that the order is delivered
Checks out a product in the store

Notified that 
the seller accepts 
the order

Notified 
that the seller 
packs the order

Shopkeeper is notified 
that the order is delivered
Picks up the product from store
Delivers the product to the customer
